title: From Perception to Protection: A Developer-Centered Study of Security and Privacy Threats in Extended Reality (XR)
authors: K. Cai, J. Zhang, Y. Li, Z. Wang, X. Chen, T. Li, and Y. Tian

summary.en: Studies XR developers' threat awareness and mitigation practices to guide developer-centered security support.
summary.zh: 研究 XR 开发者的威胁认知与缓解实践，为面向开发者的安全支持提供依据。

title: Harnessing large language models for virtual reality exploration testing: a case study
authors: Z. Qi, H. Li, H. Qin, K. Peng, S. He, and X. Qin

summary.en: Evaluates LLM entity detection, feature descriptions and spatial reasoning for black-box VR exploration testing.
summary.zh: 评估大模型在黑盒 VR 探索测试中的实体检测、特征描述与空间推理能力。

title: Vetting Privacy Policies in Virtual Reality Platforms With Longitudinal Analysis
authors: Y. Meng, Y. Huo, Y. Zhan, L. Zhou, L. Ma, G. Chen, Q. Pei, and H. Zhu

summary.en: Tracks VR platform privacy policies over time to analyze policy quality and longitudinal changes.
summary.zh: 纵向追踪 VR 平台隐私政策，分析政策质量及其变化。

title: XRFix: Exploring Performance Bug Repair of Extended Reality Applications with Large Language Models
authors: J. Wu, H. Guo, H. Dai, and X. Luo

summary.en: Introduces XRFix to generate and validate performance-bug repairs for XR applications with LLMs.
summary.zh: 提出 XRFix，利用大模型生成并验证 XR 应用的性能缺陷修复。

title: A Test Automation Framework for User Interaction in Extended Reality Applications
authors: R. Gu and J. M. Rojas

summary.en: Introduces INTENXION APIs to simulate compositional XR interactions and assert expected outcomes.
summary.zh: 提出 INTENXION，通过 API 模拟组合式 XR 交互并断言预期结果。

title: An Empirical Study on Meta Virtual Reality Applications: Security and Privacy Perspectives
authors: H. Guo, H. Dai, X. Luo, G. Xu, F. He, and Z. Zheng

summary.en: Combines static, third-party-library, privacy-policy and user-review analysis to audit Meta VR applications.
summary.zh: 结合静态、第三方库、隐私政策与用户评论分析，审计 Meta VR 应用。

title: AUTOVR: Automated UI Exploration for Detecting Sensitive Data Flow Exposures in Virtual Reality Apps
authors: J. Y. Kim, C. Zuo, Y. Zhao, and Z. Lin

summary.en: Introduces AUTOVR to explore Unity VR interfaces and expose sensitive data flows through hidden events.
summary.zh: 提出 AUTOVR，探索 Unity VR 界面，通过隐藏事件揭示敏感数据流。

title: Code Refactoring in Virtual Reality
authors: M. Giannaccari, M. Raglianti, and M. Lanza

summary.en: Explores code refactoring inside VR through spatial program visualization and controller interactions.
summary.zh: 通过空间程序可视化与控制器交互，探索在 VR 中执行代码重构。

title: CreepyCoCreator? Investigating AI Representation Modes for 3D Object Co-Creation in Virtual Reality
authors: J. Rasch, J. Töws, T. Hirzle, F. Müller, and M. Schmitz

summary.en: Studies how embodied AI representation shapes engagement, ownership and partnership in VR object co-creation.
summary.zh: 研究具身 AI 的呈现方式如何影响 VR 物体共创中的参与感、所有权与伙伴感。

title: Dreamcrafter: Immersive Editing of 3D Radiance Fields Through Flexible, Generative Inputs and Outputs
authors: C. Vachha, Y. Kang, Z. Dive, A. Chidambaram, A. Gupta, E. Jun, and B. Hartmann

summary.en: Unifies direct manipulation and generative inputs for iterative editing of immersive 3D radiance fields.
summary.zh: 结合直接操控与生成式输入，迭代编辑沉浸式三维辐射场。

title: Exploring the Design Space of Privacy-Driven Adaptation Techniques for Future Augmented Reality Interfaces
authors: S. Rajaram, M. Peralta, J. G. Johnson, and M. Nebeling

summary.en: Explores interface adaptation techniques that respond to privacy needs in AR.
summary.zh: 探索响应 AR 隐私需求的界面自适应技术。

title: Extended Reality Cybersickness Assessment via User Review Analysis
authors: S. Li, Q. Zheng, C. Gao, J. Feng, and M. R. Lyu

summary.en: Introduces XRCare to assess cybersickness through LLM-driven analysis of XR app reviews.
summary.zh: 提出 XRCare，利用大模型分析 XR 应用评论，评估晕动症。

title: GaussianShopVR: Facilitating Immersive 3D Authoring Using Gaussian Splatting in VR
authors: Y. Shen, B. Li, J. Huang, D. Yip, and Z. Wang

summary.en: Supports immersive editing and authoring of 3D Gaussian splatting content in VR.
summary.zh: 支持在 VR 中沉浸式编辑与创作三维高斯泼溅内容。

title: ImaginateAR: AI-Assisted In-Situ Authoring in Augmented Reality
authors: J. Lee, F. Aleotti, D. Mazala, G. Garcia-Hernando, S. Vicente, O. J. Johnston, I. Kraus-Liang, J. Powierza, D. Shin, J. E. Froehlich, G. Brostow, and J. Van Brummelen

summary.en: Combines scene understanding, generated 3D assets and speech interaction for in-situ AR authoring.
summary.zh: 结合场景理解、三维资产生成与语音交互，支持原位 AR 创作。

title: PipID: Light-Pupillary Response Based User Authentication for Virtual Reality
authors: M. Pan, Y. Meng, Y. Zhan, G. Chen, and H. Zhu

summary.en: Uses light-induced pupillary responses to authenticate users within VR headsets.
summary.zh: 利用光诱发瞳孔响应，在 VR 头显中实现用户身份认证。

title: Principled and Automated Approach for Investigating AR/VR Attacks
authors: M. Shoaib, A. Suh, and W. U. Hassan

summary.en: Builds AR/VR-aware provenance graphs to investigate attacks and reconstruct their causes and impacts.
summary.zh: 构建感知 AR/VR 特性的溯源图，调查攻击并重建其成因与影响。

title: RealityCrafter: User-guided Editable 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image in Mixed Reality
authors: S. Kim, D. Kim, T. Son, and W. Woo

summary.en: Generates editable mixed reality scenes from one image with user guidance.
summary.zh: 在用户引导下，从单张图像生成可编辑的混合现实场景。

title: RemapVR: An Immersive Authoring Tool for Rapid Prototyping of Remapped Interaction in VR
authors: T. Luo, T. Wu, C. Jiang, X. Duan, J. Lv, N. Li, Y. Fan, T. Han, and F. Tian

summary.en: Provides an immersive authoring tool for prototyping and inspecting remapped VR interactions.
summary.zh: 提供沉浸式创作工具，用于原型设计与检查 VR 重映射交互。

title: SecCityVR: Visualization and Collaborative Exploration of Software Vulnerabilities in Virtual Reality
authors: D. Wüppelmann and E. Yigitbas

summary.en: Uses a collaborative VR city visualization to explore software vulnerabilities and their relationships.
summary.zh: 通过协作式 VR 城市可视化，探索软件漏洞及其关联。

title: Shadowed Realities: An Investigation of UI Attacks in WebXR
authors: C. Mukherjee, R. Mohamed, A. Arunasalam, H. Farrukh, and Z. B. Celik

summary.en: Analyzes WebXR UI attacks and measures how dark designs influence immersive user behavior.
summary.zh: 分析 WebXR 界面攻击，并测量暗黑设计对沉浸式用户行为的影响。

title: SoK: Come Together – Unifying Security, Information Theory, and Cognition for a Mixed Reality Deception Attack Ontology & Analysis Framework
authors: A. Teymourian, A. M. Webb, T. Gharaibeh, A. Ghildiyal, and I. Baggili

summary.en: Unifies security, information theory and cognition in an ontology and analysis framework for MR deception attacks.
summary.zh: 结合安全、信息论与认知，建立混合现实欺骗攻击的本体与分析框架。

title: Virtual Reality, Real Problems: A Longitudinal Security Analysis of VR Firmware
authors: V. S. Simhadri, Y. Xiong, H. Farrukh, and X. Zhang

summary.en: Tracks VR firmware evolution to identify security weaknesses and the persistence of vulnerable components.
summary.zh: 追踪 VR 固件演进，识别安全弱点与易受攻击组件的持续存在。

title: VReqST: A Requirement Specification Tool for Virtual Reality Software Products
authors: S. A. Karre, A. A. Halhalli, and Y. R. Reddy

summary.en: Provides a requirements specification tool tailored to VR software products.
summary.zh: 提供面向 VR 软件产品的需求规约工具。

title: VRExplorer: A Model-based Approach for Semi-Automated Testing of Virtual Reality Scenes
authors: Z. Zhu, H. Dai, H. Guo, Z. Liao, and Z. Zheng

summary.en: Models entities, actions and tasks to guide navigation and diverse interactions during VR testing.
summary.zh: 建模实体、动作与任务，引导 VR 测试中的导航与多类型交互。

title: VRTestSniffer: Test Smell Detector for Virtual Reality (VR) Software Projects
authors: F. Gurramkonda, A. Chakroborty, B. Maxim, M. W. Mkaouer, and F. Hassan

summary.en: Detects VR-specific test smells using syntax, control-flow and data-flow analysis of Unity tests.
summary.zh: 通过语法、控制流与数据流分析，检测 Unity 测试中的 VR 特有测试异味。

title: A Novel Approach to 3D Storyboarding
authors: F. Manuri, A. Sanna, M. Scarzello, and F. De Pace

summary.en: Creates storyboards from 3D scenes, actor actions, camera settings and generated scene descriptions.
summary.zh: 根据三维场景、角色动作与相机设置生成故事板及场景描述。

title: An Empirical Study on Oculus Virtual Reality Applications: Security and Privacy Perspectives
authors: H. Guo, H. Dai, X. Luo, Z. Zheng, G. Xu, and F. He

summary.en: Combines application analysis and privacy-policy inspection to assess security and privacy in Oculus VR apps.
summary.zh: 结合应用分析与隐私政策检查，评估 Oculus VR 应用的安全和隐私。

title: Content format and quality of experience in virtual reality
authors: H. G. Debarba, M. Montagud, S. Chagué, J. G. Herrero, I. Lacosta, S. F. Langa, and C. Charbonnier

summary.en: Examines how VR content formats influence the quality of immersive viewing experiences.
summary.zh: 考察 VR 内容格式对沉浸式观看体验质量的影响。

title: EStatiG: Wearable Haptic Feedback with Multi-Phalanx Electrostatic Brake for Enhanced Object Perception in VR
authors: N. Vanichvoranun, H. Lee, S. Kim, and S. H. Yoon

summary.en: Uses a multi-phalanx electrostatic brake to provide wearable haptic feedback for perceiving virtual objects.
summary.zh: 通过多指节静电制动器提供可穿戴触觉反馈，增强虚拟物体感知。

title: Examining Psychological Conflict-Handling Strategies for Highly Automated Vehicles to Resolve Legal User-Vehicle Conflicts
authors: A. Stampf, M. Colley, A. Knuth, C. Tasci, and E. Rukzio

summary.en: Studies persuasive conflict-handling strategies in a VR driving simulator for highly automated vehicles.
summary.zh: 通过 VR 驾驶模拟研究高度自动驾驶车辆的说服型冲突处理策略。

title: Gamification of virtual museum curation: a case study of Chinese bronze wares
authors: Z. Li, Q. Zhang, J. Xu, C. Li, and X. Yang

summary.en: Combines scanned bronze artifacts, immersive museum scenes and games to support cultural learning.
summary.zh: 结合青铜器扫描模型、沉浸式博物馆场景与游戏，支持文化知识学习。

title: Grounded GUI Understanding for Vision Based Spatial Intelligent Agent: Exemplified by Virtual Reality Apps
authors: S. Li, B. Li, Y. Liu, C. Gao, J. Zhang, S. Cheung, and M. R. Lyu

summary.en: Introduces Orienter to ground context-sensitive interactable GUI elements in VR scenes with multimodal models.
summary.zh: 提出 Orienter，利用多模态模型识别 VR 场景中与上下文相关的可交互界面元素。

title: HapticPilot: Authoring In-situ Hand Posture-Adaptive Vibrotactile Feedback for Virtual Reality
authors: Y. Sung, R. Kim, K. W. Song, Y. Shao, and S. H. Yoon

summary.en: Supports authoring hand-posture-adaptive vibrotactile feedback for VR interactions.
summary.zh: 支持为 VR 交互创作适应手部姿态的振动触觉反馈。

title: Impact of Latency on QoE, Performance, and Collaboration in Interactive Multi-User Virtual Reality
authors: S. Van Damme, J. Sameri, S. Schwarzmann, Q. Wei, R. Trivisonno, F. De Turck, and M. Torres Vega

summary.en: Studies how network latency affects experience, task performance and collaboration in multi-user VR.
summary.zh: 研究网络时延对多用户 VR 体验、任务表现与协作的影响。

title: Inception Attacks: Immersive Hijacking in Virtual Reality Systems
authors: Z. Yang, C. Y. Li, A. Bhalla, B. Y. Zhao, and H. Zheng

summary.en: Demonstrates immersive hijacking by trapping users inside an application that impersonates the VR system interface.
summary.zh: 通过伪装成 VR 系统界面的应用困住用户，展示沉浸式劫持攻击。

title: Less Cybersickness, Please: Demystifying and Detecting Stereoscopic Visual Inconsistencies in Virtual Reality Apps
authors: S. Li, C. Gao, J. Zhang, Y. Zhang, Y. Liu, J. Gu, Y. Peng, and M. R. Lyu

summary.en: Introduces StereoID to detect stereoscopic visual inconsistencies from rendered left- and right-eye images.
summary.zh: 提出 StereoID，基于左右眼渲染图像检测立体视觉不一致问题。

title: M2AR: A Web-based Modeling Environment for the Augmented Reality Workflow Modeling Language
authors: F. Muff and H. Fill

summary.en: Provides a web modeling environment for specifying AR application workflows.
summary.zh: 提供用于描述 AR 应用工作流的 Web 建模环境。

title: RE Methods for Virtual Reality Software Product Development: A Mapping Study
authors: S. A. Karre, Y. R. Reddy, and R. Mittal

summary.en: Maps requirements engineering methods used in VR software product development.
summary.zh: 梳理 VR 软件产品开发中采用的需求工程方法。

title: That doesn’t go there: attacks on shared state in Multi-User augmented reality applications
authors: C. Slocum, Y. Zhang, E. Shayegani, P. Zaree, N. Abu-Ghazaleh, and J. Chen

summary.en: Shows how manipulated shared state compromises multi-user AR interactions and virtual content.
summary.zh: 展示共享状态被操纵后，多用户 AR 交互与虚拟内容面临的安全问题。

title: The Big Brother’s New Playground: Unmasking the Illusion of Privacy in Web Metaverses from a Malicious User’s Perspective
authors: Andrea Mengascini, Ryan Aurelio, Giancarlo Pellegrino

summary.en: Exploits browser-side metaverse objects to study surveillance, tracking and privacy leakage by malicious users.
summary.zh: 利用浏览器端元宇宙对象，研究恶意用户实施监视、追踪与隐私泄露的方式。

title: Towards Automatic Oracle Prediction for AR Testing: Assessing Virtual Object Placement Quality under Real-World Scenes
authors: X. Yang, Y. Wang, T. Rafi, D. Liu, X. Wang, and X. Zhang

summary.en: Combines scene metadata and learned image analysis to detect imprecise AR object placements.
summary.zh: 结合场景元数据与图像学习，检测 AR 物体放置不准确的问题。

title: Understanding Privacy in Virtual Reality Classrooms: A Contextual Integrity Perspective
authors: K. Brehm and Y. Shvartzshnaider

summary.en: Analyzes information flows in VR classrooms through contextual integrity and context-dependent privacy expectations.
summary.zh: 通过情境完整性分析 VR 课堂的信息流及情境相关的隐私预期。

title: Utilizing Generative AI for VR Exploration Testing: A Case Study
authors: X. Qin and G. Weaver

summary.en: Studies generative AI for identifying test entities and spatial features from VR field-of-view images.
summary.zh: 研究生成式 AI 从 VR 视野图像识别测试实体与空间特征的能力。

title: VPVet: Vetting Privacy Policies of Virtual Reality Apps
authors: Y. Zhan, Y. Meng, L. Zhou, Y. Xiong, X. Zhang, L. Ma, G. Chen, Q. Pei, and H. Zhu

summary.en: Introduces VPVet to analyze VR privacy policies for collection granularity, minimization and statement consistency.
summary.zh: 提出 VPVet，分析 VR 隐私政策的数据收集粒度、最小化与陈述一致性。

title: When the User Is Inside the User Interface: An Empirical Study of UI Security Properties in Augmented Reality
authors: K. Cheng, A. Bhattacharya, M. Lin, J. Lee, A. Kumar, J. F. Tian, T. Kohno, and F. Roesner

summary.en: Examines AR UI security properties through platform measurements and proof-of-concept interface attacks.
summary.zh: 通过平台测量与概念验证攻击，研究 AR 用户界面的安全属性。

title: A peek into the metaverse: detecting 3D model clones in mobile games
authors: C. Zuo, C. Wang, and Z. Lin

summary.en: Detects static and animated 3D model clones in Unity mobile games through normalized asset comparison.
summary.zh: 通过规范化资产比较，检测 Unity 移动游戏中的静态与动画三维模型克隆。

title: A Survey on Metaverse: Fundamentals, Security, and Privacy
authors: Y. Wang, Z. Su, N. Zhang, R. Xing, D. Liu, T. H. Luan, and X. Shen

summary.en: Surveys metaverse foundations alongside security and privacy threats, protections and research challenges.
summary.zh: 综述元宇宙基础，以及安全与隐私威胁、防护方法和研究挑战。

title: Analyzing augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) recent development in education
authors: A. M. Al-Ansi, M. Jaboob, A. Garad, and A. Al-Ansi

summary.en: Reviews recent AR and VR developments and their educational applications.
summary.zh: 回顾 AR 与 VR 的近期发展及其教育应用。

title: Demystifying Mobile Extended Reality in Web Browsers: How Far Can We Go?
authors: W. Bi, Y. Ma, D. Tian, Q. Yang, M. Zhang, and X. Jing

summary.en: Benchmarks mobile web XR frameworks to connect loading and frame-rate bottlenecks with implementation choices.
summary.zh: 评测移动 Web XR 框架，将加载与帧率瓶颈关联到实现选择。

title: Erebus: Access Control for Augmented Reality Systems
authors: Y. Kim, S. Goutam, A. Rahmati, and A. Kaufman

summary.en: Introduces Erebus for fine-grained, context-aware access control over AR sensing data.
summary.zh: 提出 Erebus，实现 AR 感知数据的细粒度、上下文感知访问控制。

title: Exploring the Privacy Risks of Adversarial VR Game Design
authors: V. Nair, G. Munilla Garrido, D. Song, and J. O’Brien

summary.en: Uses adversarial VR game design to investigate sensitive information exposed through gameplay and movement.
summary.zh: 利用对抗式 VR 游戏设计，研究游戏行为与运动暴露的敏感信息。

title: It’s all in your head(set): side-channel attacks on AR/VR systems
authors: Y. Zhang, C. Slocum, J. Chen, and N. Abu-Ghazaleh

summary.en: Demonstrates malware-driven side channels that infer AR/VR gestures, voice commands and virtual keystrokes.
summary.zh: 展示恶意软件侧信道对 AR/VR 手势、语音指令与虚拟键盘输入的推断。

title: Requirements Elicitation for Virtual Reality Products - A Mapping Study
authors: S. A. Karre, R. Mittal, and R. Reddy

summary.en: Maps techniques and practices for eliciting requirements of VR products.
summary.zh: 梳理 VR 产品需求获取的技术与实践。

title: Virtual Reality (VR) Automated Testing in the Wild: A Case Study on Unity-Based VR Applications
authors: D. E. Rzig, N. Iqbal, I. Attisano, X. Qin, and F. Hassan

summary.en: Characterizes automated testing practices and test categories across open-source Unity VR applications.
summary.zh: 分析开源 Unity VR 应用的自动化测试实践与测试类型。

title: VRGuide: Efficient Testing of Virtual Reality Scenes via Dynamic Cut Coverage
authors: X. Wang, T. Rafi, and N. Meng

summary.en: Uses dynamic cut coverage to guide camera movement and improve exploration of VR scenes.
summary.zh: 利用动态切面覆盖引导相机移动，提升 VR 场景探索效率。

title: A Keylogging Inference Attack on Air-Tapping Keyboards in Virtual Environments
authors: Ü. Meteriz-Yıldıran, N. F. Yıldıran, A. Awad, and D. Mohaisen

summary.en: Reconstructs air-tapped keyboard input from observable hand-motion patterns in virtual environments.
summary.zh: 基于虚拟环境中可观察的手部运动模式，重建空中敲击键盘输入。

title: A Role Based Model Template for Specifying Virtual Reality Software
authors: S. A. Karre, V. Pareek, R. Mittal, and R. Reddy

summary.en: Introduces a role-based metamodel for specifying the core elements of VR software systems.
summary.zh: 提出基于角色的元模型，用于描述 VR 软件系统的核心要素。

title: A Study of User Privacy in Android Mobile AR Apps
authors: X. Yang and X. Zhang

summary.en: Examines user privacy practices and data handling in Android mobile AR applications.
summary.zh: 考察 Android 移动 AR 应用中的用户隐私实践与数据处理。

title: Analysis of Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality SDK’s and Game Engines: A Comparison
authors: S. Angra, B. Sharma, and A. Sharma

summary.en: Compares VR and AR SDKs and game engines for application development.
summary.zh: 比较用于 VR 与 AR 应用开发的 SDK 和游戏引擎。

title: Analyzing Performance Issues of Virtual Reality Applications
authors: J. Hogan, A. Salo, D. E. Rzig, F. Hassan, and B. Maxim

summary.en: Derives Unreal Engine performance bug patterns and detects performance bugs in configuration files and C++ code.
summary.zh: 提炼虚幻引擎性能缺陷模式，并检测配置文件与 C++ 代码中的性能缺陷。

title: Beyond Genre: Classifying Virtual Reality Experiences
authors: M. Foxman, D. Beyea, A. P. Leith, R. A. Ratan, V. H. H. Chen, and B. Klebig

summary.en: Classifies VR experiences beyond conventional game genres to support platform discovery and comparison.
summary.zh: 超越传统游戏类型划分 VR 体验，支持平台中的内容发现与比较。

title: DyTRec: A Dynamic Testing Recommendation tool for Unity-based Virtual Reality Software
authors: X. Qin and F. Hassan

summary.en: Recommends dynamic test types by analyzing Unity APIs and their use in VR source code.
summary.zh: 分析 Unity API 及其在 VR 源代码中的使用，推荐动态测试类型。

title: Effects of simulated augmented reality cueing in a virtual navigation task
authors: J. K. Stefanucci, D. Brickler, H. C. Finney, E. Wilson, T. Drew, and S. H. Creem-Regehr

summary.en: Evaluates AR-style navigation cues through spatial learning, cognitive load and situational awareness in VR.
summary.zh: 在 VR 中评估 AR 式导航提示对空间学习、认知负荷与情境感知的影响。

title: Elements of XR Prototyping: Characterizing the Role and Use of Prototypes in Augmented and Virtual Reality Design
authors: V. Krauß, M. Nebeling, F. Jasche, and A. Boden

summary.en: Characterizes how prototypes support design work across AR and VR projects.
summary.zh: 分析原型在 AR 与 VR 项目设计中的作用与使用方式。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Exploring Privacy Risks of Mobile Augmented Reality Applications
authors: S. M. Lehman, A. S. Alrumayh, K. Kolhe, H. Ling, and C. C. Tan

summary.en: Examines hidden operations in mobile AR and develops defenses against privacy-invasive interactions.
summary.zh: 分析移动 AR 的隐藏操作，并设计保护用户隐私的交互机制。

title: HoloLogger: Keystroke Inference on Mixed Reality Head Mounted Displays
authors: S. Luo, X. Hu, and Z. Yan

summary.en: Introduces HoloLogger to infer virtual keystrokes on mixed-reality head-mounted displays.
summary.zh: 提出 HoloLogger，推断混合现实头戴显示器上的虚拟键盘输入。

title: Modeling and Defense of Social Virtual Reality Attacks Inducing Cybersickness
authors: S. Valluripally, A. Gulhane, K. A. Hoque, and P. Calyam

summary.en: Models attacks that induce cybersickness in social VR and evaluates defenses with attack-fault trees.
summary.zh: 通过攻击故障树建模社交 VR 中诱发晕动症的攻击，并评估防御机制。

title: OVRseen: Auditing Network Traffic and Privacy Policies in Oculus VR
authors: R. Trimananda, H. Le, H. Cui, J. T. Ho, A. Shuba, and A. Markopoulou

summary.en: Audits Oculus VR network traffic against privacy policies to examine data collection and disclosure.
summary.zh: 对照隐私政策审计 Oculus VR 网络流量，研究数据收集与披露。

title: Playing Without Paying: Detecting Vulnerable Payment Verification in Native Binaries of Unity Mobile Games
authors: C. Zuo and Z. Lin

summary.en: Analyzes native Unity game binaries to detect vulnerable in-app payment verification.
summary.zh: 分析 Unity 游戏原生二进制，检测存在漏洞的应用内支付验证。

title: PredART: Towards automatic oracle prediction of object placements in augmented reality testing
authors: T. Rafi, X. Zhang, and X. Wang

summary.en: Predicts human judgments of virtual object placement to automate AR usability oracles.
summary.zh: 预测人类对虚拟物体放置质量的判断，构建 AR 可用性测试预言。

title: Reality Check of Metaverse: A First Look at Commercial Social Virtual Reality Platforms
authors: R. Cheng, N. Wu, S. Chen, and B. Han

summary.en: Measures commercial social VR networking to characterize multimedia delivery, protocol use and bandwidth demands.
summary.zh: 测量商用社交 VR 的网络协议、多媒体传输与带宽需求。

title: Security and privacy evaluation of popular augmented and virtual reality technologies
authors: N. Noah, S. Shearer, and S. Das

summary.en: Evaluates authentication, user profiling and access control in popular AR/VR technologies.
summary.zh: 评估主流 AR/VR 技术的身份认证、用户画像与访问控制。

title: Security of Virtual Reality Authentication Methods in Metaverse: An Overview
authors: Pınar Kürtünlüoğlu, Beste Akdik, Enis Karaarslan

summary.en: Compares knowledge-based, biometric and multimodal authentication methods for VR environments and metaverse access.
summary.zh: 比较 VR 环境与元宇宙访问中的知识型、生物特征和多模态身份认证方法。

title: Software Engineering for Augmented Reality - A Research Agenda
authors: I. Börsting, M. Heikamp, M. Hesenius, W. Koop, and V. Gruhn

summary.en: Reviews software engineering for AR and develops a research agenda for its methods and tools.
summary.zh: 回顾 AR 软件工程，提出面向方法与工具的研究议程。

title: Virtual Reality in Healthcare: A Survey
authors: Dorota Kamińska, Grzegorz Zwoliński, Anna Laska-Leśniewicz, Luis Pinto Coelho
venue: Emerging Advancements for Virtual and Augmented Reality in Healthcare

summary.en: Surveys VR applications in therapy, rehabilitation and medical education.
summary.zh: 综述 VR 在治疗、康复与医学教育中的应用。

title: VR4HcRE: Virtual Reality Platform for Human-centric Requirements Elicitation
authors: Y. Wang, X. Liu, B. Cheng, C. Arora, and T. Hoang

summary.en: Provides a VR platform for human-centered requirements elicitation.
summary.zh: 提供面向人的 VR 需求获取平台。

title: VRTest: An extensible framework for automatic testing of virtual reality scenes
authors: X. Wang

summary.en: Automates VR scene exploration through camera control and random or greedy interaction strategies.
summary.zh: 通过相机控制与随机或贪心交互策略，自动探索 VR 场景。

title: Will Metaverse Be NextG Internet? Vision, Hype, and Reality
authors: R. Cheng, N. Wu, S. Chen, and B. Han

summary.en: Compares commercial metaverse platforms to connect network performance with deployment requirements and future infrastructure.
summary.zh: 比较商用元宇宙平台，将网络性能与部署需求及基础设施研究连接起来。

title: A Survey on Mobile Augmented Reality With 5G Mobile Edge Computing: Architectures, Applications, and Technical Aspects
authors: Y. Siriwardhana, P. Porambage, M. Liyanage, and M. Ylianttila

summary.en: Surveys mobile AR architectures, applications and technical challenges enabled by 5G mobile edge computing.
summary.zh: 综述 5G 移动边缘计算支持的移动 AR 架构、应用与技术挑战。

title: AdCube: WebVR Ad Fraud and Practical Confinement of Third-Party Ads
authors: H. Lee, J. Lee, D. Kim, S. Jana, I. Shin, and S. Son

summary.en: Exposes WebVR advertising fraud and designs confinement mechanisms for third-party immersive advertisements.
summary.zh: 揭示 WebVR 广告欺诈，并设计第三方沉浸式广告隔离机制。

title: Automatic Extraction of Code Dependency in Virtual Reality Software
authors: J. Molina, X. Qin, and X. Wang

summary.en: Extracts code dependencies from VR software to support program understanding.
summary.zh: 提取 VR 软件中的代码依赖，支持程序理解。

title: Current practices, challenges, and design implications for collaborative AR/VR application development
authors: V. Krauß, A. Boden, L. Oppermann, and R. Reiners

summary.en: Interviews AR/VR professionals to identify development roles, collaboration challenges and tool needs.
summary.zh: 访谈 AR/VR 从业者，识别开发角色、协作挑战与工具需求。

title: Distributed Microscopic Traffic Simulation with Human-in-the-Loop Enabled by Virtual Reality Technologies
authors: M. Hasan, D. Perez, Y. Shen, and H. Yang

summary.en: Integrates VR human participation with distributed microscopic traffic simulation.
summary.zh: 将 VR 中的人员参与融入分布式微观交通仿真。

title: How Developers Optimize Virtual Reality Applications: A Study of Optimization Commits in Open Source Unity Projects
authors: F. Nusrat, F. Hassan, H. Zhong, and X. Wang

summary.en: Classifies real-world Unity VR optimizations across graphics, rendering and memory management.
summary.zh: 分类真实 Unity VR 项目中的图形简化、渲染与内存优化。

title: Immersive Video Sketching: Low-Fidelity Extended Reality Prototyping for Everyone
authors: O. T. Buruk and J. Hamari

summary.en: Uses immersive video sketching to create accessible, low-fidelity XR experience prototypes.
summary.zh: 使用沉浸式视频草图创建易于制作的低保真 XR 体验原型。

title: POSTER: ReAvatar: Virtual Reality De-anonymization Attack Through Correlating Movement Signatures
authors: B. Falk, Y. Meng, Y. Zhan, and H. Zhu

summary.en: Correlates movement signatures across VR sessions to study user de-anonymization.
summary.zh: 关联不同 VR 会话中的运动特征，研究用户去匿名化。

title: Research and Practice Recommendations for Mixed Reality Design – Different Perspectives from the Community
authors: V. Krauß, F. Jasche, S. M. Saßmannshausen, T. Ludwig, and A. Boden

summary.en: Collects community perspectives to derive mixed reality design and research recommendations.
summary.zh: 汇集社区观点，形成混合现实设计与研究建议。

title: VR-Spy: A Side-Channel Attack on Virtual Key-Logging in VR Headsets
authors: A. A. Arafat, Z. Guo, and A. Awad

summary.en: Demonstrates a side-channel attack that recovers virtual keyboard input from VR headsets.
summary.zh: 展示从 VR 头显恢复虚拟键盘输入的侧信道攻击。

title: 3D Photography Using Context-Aware Layered Depth Inpainting
authors: M. Shih, S. Su, J. Kopf, and J. Huang

summary.en: Converts RGB-D images into layered 3D photos through context-aware color and depth inpainting.
summary.zh: 通过感知上下文的颜色与深度补全，将 RGB-D 图像转换为分层三维照片。

title: Agent-based testing of extended reality systems
authors: R. Prada, I. Prasetya, F. Kifetew, F. Dignum, T. E. Vos, J. Lander, J. Donnart, A. Kazmierowski, J. Davidson, and P. M. Fernandes

summary.en: Combines autonomous cognitive test agents with emotion modeling to assess XR behavior and user experience.
summary.zh: 结合自主认知测试代理与情感建模，评估 XR 行为和用户体验。

title: An Empirical Analysis of Unity Performance Bugs
authors: Nusrat,Fariha

summary.en: Analyzes Unity performance fixes to connect source-code changes with prefab and asset modifications.
summary.zh: 分析 Unity 性能修复，揭示源代码修改与预制体及资产修改之间的联系。

title: An Exploratory Study of Bugs in Extended Reality Applications on the Web
authors: S. Li, Y. Wu, Y. Liu, D. Wang, M. Wen, Y. Tao, Y. Sui, and Y. Liu

summary.en: Builds a WebXR bug taxonomy covering device incompatibility, interaction handling and application failures.
summary.zh: 构建 WebXR 缺陷分类，涵盖设备不兼容、交互处理与应用故障。

title: ARCHIE: A user-focused framework for testing augmented reality applications in the wild
authors: S. M. Lehman, H. Ling, and C. C. Tan

summary.en: Connects user feedback with runtime telemetry to diagnose AR performance and usability problems.
summary.zh: 将用户反馈与运行遥测关联，定位 AR 性能与可用性问题。

title: ARKit and ARCore in serve to augmented reality
authors: Z. Oufqir, A. El Abderrahmani, and K. Satori

summary.en: Examines ARKit and ARCore as platforms for building augmented reality applications.
summary.zh: 分析 ARKit 与 ARCore 在增强现实应用开发中的作用。

title: Detecting Video Game-Specific Bad Smells in Unity Projects
authors: A. Borrelli, V. Nardone, G. A. Di Lucca, G. Canfora, and M. Di Penta

summary.en: Introduces UnityLinter to detect game-specific performance, maintainability and behavioral smells.
summary.zh: 提出 UnityLinter，检测游戏特有的性能、可维护性与行为异味。

title: Effects of steering locomotion and teleporting on cybersickness and presence in HMD-based virtual reality
authors: J. Clifton and S. Palmisano

summary.en: Compares steering and teleportation locomotion through cybersickness and presence measurements.
summary.zh: 通过晕动症与临场感测量比较转向移动和传送移动。

title: Modern Virtual Reality Headsets
authors: V. Angelov, E. Petkov, G. Shipkovenski, and T. Kalushkov

summary.en: Reviews modern VR headsets and their characteristics for immersive interaction.
summary.zh: 回顾现代 VR 头显及其沉浸式交互特性。

title: OcuLock: Exploring human visual system for authentication in virtual reality head-mounted display
authors: S. Luo, A. Nguyen, C. Song, F. Lin, W. Xu, and Z. Yan

summary.en: Uses human visual-system responses for biometric authentication in VR head-mounted displays.
summary.zh: 利用人类视觉系统响应，在 VR 头戴显示器中实现生物特征认证。

title: VRSketchIn: Exploring the Design Space of Pen and Tablet Interaction for 3D Sketching in Virtual Reality
authors: T. Drey, J. Gugenheimer, J. Karlbauer, M. Milo, and E. Rukzio

summary.en: Explores pen-and-tablet interaction techniques for 3D sketching in VR.
summary.zh: 探索在 VR 中使用数字笔与平板进行三维草图绘制的交互技术。

title: WalkingVibe: Reducing Virtual Reality Sickness and Improving Realism while Walking in VR using Unobtrusive Head-mounted Vibrotactile Feedback
authors: Y. Peng, C. Yu, S. Liu, C. Wang, P. Taele, N. Yu, and M. Y. Chen

summary.en: Studies head-mounted vibrotactile feedback for reducing sickness and improving walking realism in VR.
summary.zh: 研究通过头戴式振动触觉反馈缓解 VR 晕动症并改善行走真实感。

title: 360proto: Making Interactive Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality Prototypes from Paper
authors: M. Nebeling and K. Madier

summary.en: Turns paper sketches into interactive VR and AR prototypes for rapid experience validation.
summary.zh: 将纸面草图转化为可交互的 VR 与 AR 原型，支持快速体验验证。

title: Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality in Education. Myth or Reality?
authors: N. Elmqaddem
venue: International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning

summary.en: Discusses AR and VR adoption in education and the opportunities for immersive learning.
summary.zh: 讨论 AR 与 VR 在教育中的应用及沉浸式学习机会。

title: Secure Multi-User Content Sharing for Augmented Reality Applications
authors: K. Ruth, T. Kohno, and F. Roesner

summary.en: Defines secure multi-user AR content sharing with permissions grounded in physical and virtual context.
summary.zh: 基于物理与虚拟上下文定义权限，实现多用户 AR 内容的安全共享。

title: What You Sketch Is What You Get: Quick and Easy Augmented Reality Prototyping with PintAR
authors: D. Gasques, J. G. Johnson, T. Sharkey, and N. Weibel

summary.en: Lets designers sketch with a digital pen and interact with the resulting AR prototypes.
summary.zh: 支持设计者使用数字笔绘制草图，并与生成的 AR 原型交互。

title: A virtual agent toolkit for serious games developers
authors: S. Mascarenhas, M. Guimarães, R. Prada, J. Dias, P. A. Santos, K. Star, B. Hirsh, E. Spice, and R. Kommeren

summary.en: Provides the FAtiMA toolkit for authoring virtual agents with emotional and social behavior.
summary.zh: 提供 FAtiMA 工具包，支持具有情感与社会行为的虚拟代理开发。

title: An automated functional testing approach for virtual reality applications
authors: A. C. Correa Souza, F. L. Nunes, and M. E. Delamaro

summary.en: Generates functional test requirements and data from semiformal specifications of VR behavior.
summary.zh: 从 VR 行为的半形式化规约生成测试需求与功能测试数据。

title: Forensic Analysis of Immersive Virtual Reality Social Applications: A Primary Account
authors: A. Yarramreddy, P. Gromkowski, and I. Baggili

summary.en: Examines forensic artifacts of immersive social VR applications to reconstruct user activity.
summary.zh: 检查沉浸式社交 VR 应用的取证工件，重建用户活动。

title: The State of Practice on Virtual Reality (VR) Applications: An Exploratory Study on Github and Stack Overflow
authors: N. Ghrairi, S. Kpodjedo, A. Barrak, F. Petrillo, and F. Khomh

summary.en: Studies VR application development practices through GitHub projects and Stack Overflow discussions.
summary.zh: 通过 GitHub 项目与 Stack Overflow 讨论研究 VR 应用开发实践。

title: UMI3D: A Unity3D Toolbox to Support CSCW Systems Properties in Generic 3D User Interfaces
authors: J. Casarin, N. Pacqueriaud, and D. Bechmann

summary.en: Offers a Unity toolbox for generic 3D interfaces that support collaborative work.
summary.zh: 提供 Unity 工具箱，支持面向协同工作的通用三维界面。

title: The virtual reality head-mounted display Oculus Rift induces motion sickness and is sexist in its effects
authors: J. Munafo, M. Diedrick, and T. A. Stoffregen

summary.en: Measures motion sickness and postural responses during Oculus Rift gameplay.
summary.zh: 测量 Oculus Rift 游戏过程中的晕动症与姿态反应。

title: Virtual reality system for training in automotive mechanics
authors: W. X. Quevedo, J. S. Sánchez, O. Arteaga, M. Álvarez V, V. D. Zambrano, C. R. Sánchez, and V. H. Andaluz

summary.en: Builds a VR automotive mechanics training system around practical maintenance tasks.
summary.zh: 围绕实际维修任务构建汽车机械技能 VR 训练系统。

title: Review on cybersickness in applications and visual displays
authors: L. Rebenitsch and C. Owen

summary.en: Reviews cybersickness factors, measurement approaches and mitigation across immersive applications and visual displays.
summary.zh: 梳理沉浸式应用与视觉显示中的晕动症因素、测量方法和缓解策略。

title: Sketching up the World: In Situ Authoring for Mobile Augmented Reality
authors: T. Langlotz, S. Mooslechner, S. Zollmann, C. Degendorfer, G. Reitmayr, and D. Schmalstieg

summary.en: Enables smartphone users to sketch and create mobile AR content in its physical context.
summary.zh: 支持用户通过手机在真实环境中绘制并创建移动 AR 内容。

title: In-Place Sketching for Content Authoring in Augmented Reality Games
authors: N. Hagbi, R. Grasset, O. Bergig, M. Billinghurst, and J. El-Sana

summary.en: Explores in-place sketching as a visual language for authoring AR game content.
summary.zh: 探索将原位草图作为创作 AR 游戏内容的视觉语言。

title: Health and safety implications of virtual reality: a review of empirical evidence
authors: S. Nichols and H. Patel

summary.en: Reviews empirical evidence on health and safety effects associated with VR use.
summary.zh: 回顾 VR 使用对健康与安全影响的实证证据。

title: A discussion of cybersickness in virtual environments
authors: J. J. LaViola Jr

summary.en: Discusses causes, symptoms and mitigation approaches for cybersickness in virtual environments.
summary.zh: 讨论虚拟环境中晕动症的原因、症状与缓解方法。

title: Virtual reality on a WIM: interactive worlds in miniature
authors: R. Stoakley, M. J. Conway, and R. Pausch

summary.en: Introduces worlds-in-miniature for viewing and manipulating a virtual environment through a small-scale representation.
summary.zh: 提出微缩世界交互，通过小比例表示查看和操纵虚拟环境。
